page_text_ocr_zh:
亲爱的宝宝
你有没有帮妈妈扫地的时候碰翻了花瓶，
试图去洗碗却打翻了盆，
想去洗衣服却弄得自己成了落汤鸡？……
妈妈是不是摇着头说“哦，天哪！”？
没关系的，宝宝，不要退缩，
总有一天，
你会做得很好！
——谭旭东
page_text_en:
Dear Baby
Have you ever knocked over a vase while helping Mom sweep the floor,
tried to wash dishes but knocked over a basin,
or tried to wash clothes and ended up soaked like a drowned chicken?……
Did Mom shake her head and say, "Oh, my goodness!"?
It's okay, baby, don't back down,
One day,
you'll do it perfectly!
— Tan Xudong
summary_zh: 本页是绘本的寄语页，作者谭旭东以温暖的口吻鼓励孩子，即使在帮忙做家务时犯错，也不要气馁，因为总有一天会做得很好。

page_text_ocr_zh:
爸爸妈妈知道吗？

您的宝宝也许正处于热衷“帮忙”的时期，但由于经验和能力不足，常常好心办“坏事”，帮忙变成了帮倒忙。当宝宝仰着小脸，兴致勃勃地恳求“妈妈，我来帮帮你吧”时，究竟是不耐烦地拒绝他，还是接受他的帮忙，同时鼓励他？

“帮忙”能让宝宝增加责任感，所以我们应该赞扬宝宝的行为。要相信宝宝的“越帮越忙”是暂时的，而他的生活能力和责任感，将会在“越帮越忙”中得以发展。所以，请您用温柔来包容和欣赏宝宝的小过失。

爸爸妈妈应该给宝宝充足的时间让他去实践，给宝宝独立的空间让他去发挥，再给宝宝适合的工具帮助他完成“帮忙”。放宽对宝宝的要求，让宝宝力所能及、循序渐进地“帮忙”。

如果还是一塌糊涂，就和宝宝一起收拾“战场”吧！

——谭旭东
page_text_en:
Parents, do you know?

Your baby might be in the phase of being eager to 'help', but due to lack of experience and ability, they often mean well but cause 'messes', turning help into a hindrance. When your baby looks up with excitement and earnestly asks, 'Mom, let me help you!', should you reject them impatiently, or accept their help and encourage them?

'Helping' can foster a sense of responsibility in your child, so we should praise their efforts. Believe that your child's 'the more they help, the more they mess up' is temporary, and their life skills and sense of responsibility will develop through this process. So, please respond with gentleness, embracing and appreciating your child's small mistakes.

Parents should give your child enough time to practice, provide them with independent space to explore, and offer suitable tools to help them complete their 'helping'. Loosen your expectations, allowing your child to help within their capabilities, step by step.

If it's still a mess, clean up the 'battlefield' together with your child!

— Tan Xudong
summary_zh: 本页为家长指导页，以问答形式探讨孩子热衷帮忙但常弄巧成拙的现象，建议家长应包容、鼓励并引导孩子在实践中发展责任感和生活能力，最后以幽默口吻建议与孩子一起收拾残局。

中国作家协会会员，著名儿童文学作家，现任北京北方工业大学文学与传媒艺术研究中心主任、英语硕士点责任带头人、中文系教授。
已出版童诗集、童话集和散文集12部，其诗文被翻译成阿拉伯语、德语、英语、波兰语、韩语等在海外发表。文学理论批评著作10部。主编、翻译童书近300部。曾获得冰心儿童图书奖、冰心儿童文学奖、《少年文艺》优秀作品奖、《儿童文学》十大魅力诗人奖、北方十二省市文艺图书评奖二等奖、中国童书金奖和第五届鲁迅文学奖。
谭旭东
page_text_en:
Member of the China Writers Association, renowned children's literature writer, currently serving as Director of the Center for Literary and Media Arts Research, Head of the English Master's Program, and Professor of Chinese at Beijing North University of Technology.
Has published 12 collections of children's poetry, fairy tales, and essays. His poetry and prose have been translated into Arabic, German, English, Polish, and Korean and published overseas. He has authored 10 works on literary theory and criticism. He has edited and translated nearly 300 children's books. He has won awards including the Bingxin Children's Book Award, Bingxin Children's Literature Award, Outstanding Work Award from 'Youth Literature', Top Ten Charismatic Poet Award from 'Children's Literature', Second Prize in the Literary and Art Book Award of 12 Northern Provinces and Cities, China Children's Book Gold Award, and the Fifth Lu Xun Literary Award.
Tan Xudong
